declaration: PROTECTED PREVIEW SUCCESS DOES NOT AUTHORIZE PUBLIC LAUNCH.

launchGates.name: Protected preview reconciliation
evidence: reports/lp1837/lp1837-summary.json: deployment/artifact, Access, device-browser validation, isolation and token closure are recorded
launchGates.notes: Bounded preview success only; no redeployment is required. PROTECTED PREVIEW SUCCESS DOES NOT AUTHORIZE PUBLIC LAUNCH.

launchGates.name: Final consumer legal approval
remainingActions: Resolve attorney-review register; approve dated final Privacy Policy and Terms; set effective date; preserve age 16 and Texas decisions subject to counsel.
launchGates.notes: Draft completeness and owner decisions are not attorney approval.

launchGates.name: Operational support and privacy contacts
remainingActions: Prove support@gridlygo.com and privacy@gridlygo.com can receive and answer mail without capturing message contents or credentials.
launchGates.notes: Planned addresses are not operational evidence.

launchGates.name: Apple App Privacy declaration
evidence: reports/lp1841b/store-privacy-uncertainty-register.json: Apple location/content/id/search and retention questions open
remainingActions: Resolve precise-location collection, transient provider transmission, stored report coordinates, linkage, sharing, purpose, retention and deletion interpretations; enter the approved mapping in App Store Connect.
launchGates.notes: Repository mapping is not Apple review or approval.

launchGates.name: Google Play Data Safety declaration
remainingActions: Resolve taxonomy and sharing/exclusion treatment; separately declare server-stored community-report coordinates and transient OSRM/Nominatim/provider requests; enter approved answers in Play Console.
launchGates.notes: Repository mapping is not Google review or approval.

launchGates.name: Subscription and purchase implementation
evidence: Repository audit: no store product IDs, purchase/entitlement/restore implementation, configured products, or production validation evidence
remainingActions: Implement governed purchase, entitlement, cancellation/disclosure and restore flows; configure Apple and Google products separately; validate production purchase receipts later.
launchGates.notes: Business decision COMPLETE. Apple product, Google product, architecture, restore handling, product IDs and production validation NOT_STARTED.

launchGates.name: Android signed production build
evidence: android/app/build.gradle: com.gridly.app; versionCode 1/versionName 1.0; no release/signing block
android/gradlew and wrapper properties exist; tracked wrapper JAR absent
remainingActions: Complete repository-safe release configuration; owner supplies signing externally; produce a signed AAB and capture hash/build identity; upload only under later authorization.
launchGates.notes: Native project exists. No keystore/secrets are expected in Git. No release artifact or Play-ready AAB evidence exists.

launchGates.name: iOS archive and signing
evidence: ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj: placeholder project has no build settings
remainingActions: Complete Xcode project/version/team configuration on governed macOS; archive/sign; capture archive identity; upload only under later authorization.
launchGates.notes: Source presence is not archive success. No archive, IPA, TestFlight or App Store Connect build evidence exists.

launchGates.name: Physical packaged Android validation
remainingActions: Exercise the signed/closed-test Android app on physical supported hardware and retain non-sensitive results.
launchGates.notes: Browser preview evidence is explicitly not native Android evidence.

launchGates.name: Physical packaged iPhone validation
remainingActions: Exercise the TestFlight/native iOS app on physical supported iPhone hardware and retain non-sensitive results.
launchGates.notes: Safari/PWA evidence is explicitly not packaged-iOS evidence.

launchGates.name: Store metadata and assets
evidence: assets/store/apple and assets/store/google contain placeholders; screenshot directories contain no tracked screenshots
remainingActions: Approve listing copy, category/rating, URLs and review notes; create/validate required platform renditions, screenshots and Google graphic; upload in each console and capture status.
launchGates.notes: Existence does not prove compliance, final approval, or upload.

launchGates.name: Apple account and commercial console
remainingActions: Prove entity enrollment, App Store Connect role/app record, agreements and paid-app tax/banking status without capturing sensitive financial data.

launchGates.name: Google account and commercial console
remainingActions: Prove Play Console/app record, merchant/payments requirements, agreements and applicable closed-testing track/process without sensitive data.

launchGates.name: Production backend, configuration and secrets
evidence: reports/lp169 and lp17x: governance preparation does not establish current live production configuration
remainingActions: Attest required variable presence/ownership (not values); validate production Supabase migrations/RLS/functions/storage, provider configuration, separation, least privilege and leak controls.
launchGates.notes: Owner/platform-managed secret absence from Git is correct; operational evidence remains required.

launchGates.name: Statewide Texas runtime scope
evidence: reports/lp151/validation-summary.json: 254 identities, exactly 28 operational counties, zero activation/deployment
reports/lp178/launch-readiness-report.json: blanket LP167-B001 retired; 11 county-specific restrictions preserved
remainingActions: Reconcile and approve the truthful launch cohort; resolve 11 county-specific restrictions before claiming unrestricted statewide Texas runtime coverage.
launchGates.notes: Manufactured/certified: 254. Runtime operational: 28. Deployment/activation: 0. Statewide architecture/manufacturing does not equal statewide admission.

launchGates.name: Production operations and monitoring
remainingActions: Prove live health checks, monitoring/telemetry/error visibility, escalation, incident response, deployment verification and production rollback/withdrawal ownership; document store-release rollback limitations.
launchGates.notes: Repository preparation and preview controls are not live production proof.

launchGates.name: Public legal/support web and root domain
remainingActions: Publish approved privacy, terms and support surfaces at stable public URLs in a later authorized milestone; validate them before store submission; decide and separately authorize any root-domain/DNS change.
launchGates.notes: No DNS, publication or preview promotion is authorized here.

launchGates.name: Final owner submission and launch authorization
remainingActions: After prerequisite evidence, issue explicit scoped authorizations separately for store submission, distribution/release, production activation and public launch.
launchGates.notes: LP185 grants none of these authorizations.

ownerChecklist.evidence: Dated approval, final document identities, resolved-issue register
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: Privileged advice, signatures beyond necessary approval evidence

ownerChecklist.what: Verify support and privacy mailboxes end-to-end.
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: Passwords, OTPs, recovery codes, message contents

ownerChecklist.what: Prove Apple and Google organization/account/commercial prerequisites.
ownerChecklist.where: App Store Connect and Play Console

ownerChecklist.what: Configure separate $2.99 monthly products after implementation is approved.
ownerChecklist.where: App Store Connect and Play Console
ownerChecklist.evidence: Product IDs/status/pricing-territory summary and disclosure identity

ownerChecklist.what: Provide signing access externally and capture signed release identities.
ownerChecklist.where: Governed Android build host and macOS/Xcode
ownerChecklist.evidence: Version/build, SHA-256, signing certificate fingerprint/expiry, AAB/archive status
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: Private keys, keystores, provisioning contents, passwords

ownerChecklist.what: Validate packaged apps on physical Android and iPhone devices.
ownerChecklist.evidence: Device/OS/app build matrix and pass/fail observations
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: Device identifiers, tester credentials, personal data

ownerChecklist.what: Approve and upload final store metadata/assets and public URLs.
ownerChecklist.where: Both store consoles and authorized public web host
ownerChecklist.evidence: Asset/listing versions, console status, reachable URL checks
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: Console credentials or reviewer personal data

ownerChecklist.what: Prove production configuration and operations without values.
ownerChecklist.evidence: Presence/owner/expiry attestation, read-only validations, alert/incident/rollback exercises
ownerChecklist.mustNotCapture: API secrets, tokens, database credentials, private keys

ownerChecklist.what: Approve truthful Texas launch scope and resolve county restrictions.
ownerChecklist.evidence: Approved county cohort and disposition of all 11 restrictions

ownerChecklist.what: Issue explicit scoped submission, distribution, activation and public-launch decisions.
ownerChecklist.where: Final governance record after all gates close
ownerChecklist.evidence: Dated owner decision, artifact/release identities and window

proposedLaunchSequence.step: Repository: close purchase, native configuration, metadata and privacy-map gaps
Attorney/legal: approve final documents, disclosures and interpretations
Owner: verify contacts and both platform/account prerequisites
Production: configure and validate backend, secrets-by-presence and operations
Apple/Google: configure products and app records under separate authorization
Build/sign: create identity-recorded Android AAB and iOS archive
Physical device: complete Play closed-test and TestFlight validation
Public web: publish and verify approved legal/support URLs under authorization
Store submission: owner separately authorizes and submits each platform
Review: answer store review and reconcile approved release candidates
Release authorization: owner explicitly approves distribution and launch scope/window
Public activation: perform separately authorized production/domain/store release actions
Post-launch: verify health, purchases, support, telemetry and incident/withdrawal controls
